6.12 rsCompilerErrorInCode
rsCompilerErrorInCode is a critical error that will occur whenever a Report.Code element contains a
compile error. For example, if the first line in a Report.Code element is set to "myFunction()", where
"myFunction()" is not a declared or recognizable function, this error will occur.
